reviews.text:
**'Dunkin Wonders Gangnam (formerly Dunkin Live)'** is a special place that is completely different from regular Dunkin' stores.
​Open Kitchen (Live Kitchen): Normal stores sell factory-made donuts, but here, bakers (Orange Crew) knead and fry the donuts in an open kitchen. So, if you're lucky, you might see freshly fried, warm donuts.
​Menus sold only here: Premium menus such as ‘Handmade Gourmet Donuts’, ‘Eggs Benedict Donuts’, and 32-layer croissant donuts are limited menu items that can only be tasted here (Wonders store).
​Difference in taste: It has a much moister and softer texture than the factory-made product, so many people say, "It's not the Dunkin' I used to know."

“New Dunkin’, A Whole New World of Fresh Donuts!”
​It is super close to Gangnam Station! 🚇 The store is renewed as 'Dunkin' Wonders', so the facility is very clean and the interior is hip like a trendy cafe. ✨
​Especially, there is an open kitchen inside, so you can see them making donuts. The best part is that you can eat fresh donuts made right here, not from a factory! 🍩👨‍🍳 The atmosphere is great for chatting with friends or working alone. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Sunghyuk Lee

I packed everything from Lemon Delight Puffs to seasonal Seolhyang Strawberry and Raspberry, and everyone in my family praised how delicious it was. 🎁 The packaging is neat and hygienic, so I highly recommend it for dessert packaging or as a gift in Gangnam!

reviews.text: Wow, Korea’s Dunkin’ seems to be the best in the world. The woman working at 11am on a Saturday morning was really kind. I am surprised by the kindness of Korean people every time I come to Korea. When I told them I couldn't do QR check-in because I didn't know, they immediately kindly guided me through what to open.  And then immediately I started organizing the shelves again.  This person may be a part-time worker, but he is so passionate about his store that he goes all the way through the roof and into space.  Dunkin' Coffee is famous in the United States, but among the few other countries I've been to, this cappuccino I drank today was the best. Pudding shaved ice. What kind of crazy synergy will it create when delicious food + delicious food are added? I had vague expectations, but the taste was disappointing and did not meet my expectations. A pudding that tastes similar to the Crayon Shin-chan collaboration pudding sold at GS25. Insanely sweet caramel syrup, and even cookie powder that looks like brown sugar. (Estimated Lotus) I hope the taste improves further next time I come.

The soufflé was very fluffy, and it tasted a bit like raw eggs, as if vanilla extract was not used separately. When I eat shaved ice and then eat a soufflé, it feels like I'm eating a beaten egg.

The seats are spacious and the interior is clean. The air conditioner is on full blast so it's crazy cold inside, but if you ask for a blanket at the counter, they'll give it to you. Another good thing is that you can change the coffee menu to decaf. If you're curious, it wouldn't be a bad idea to visit this cafe at least once.

Since shaved ice is 19,000 won, it’s more expensive than 4 cups of Americano (4,500 won)?
Three people must order one more menu item other than shaved ice.

A place where guests are treated hospitably.

The tables were placed close together in a small space to accommodate a lot of people, so people's voices echoed loudly and it was very hectic.
I can't even hear my companions' voices, but the bar is quieter than this.
If you think my voice is louder, go for it.

Shaved ice flavor? Cookie flavor? If you pay this price and it doesn't taste good, you should close the place.
Poor cost-effectiveness.  Please note that the amount is really small.
Never revisit.

I finally went because I thought I couldn't go if it wasn't now.
It opens at 10:30, so I planned to arrive around 8:30 and have some time to relax.
I arrived around 8:40 and my number on the tabling was 38😱
I underestimated Comm Da Vitude’s popularity.
I climbed up the hill thinking what would happen if it was the first time... 😁

I kept refreshing the tabling app and waited.
It was around 12 o'clock when we entered.
My heart sank when I saw all the desserts prepared.

There are so many different types.
There are probably over 30 types of sandwiches, baked goods, pastries, baguettes, gateau, etc.
It's ridiculous that it costs well over 100,000 won if you include all the things you want to eat.

It's not easy to choose because nothing doesn't look delicious, but once you try it, you'll want to try the things you didn't choose.

In particular, the feuitaju is truly fantastic and has different charms whether you eat it the first day you get it or the next day.

reviews.author: Hiroshi Kamiya
reviews.text: They always roll the kimbap plump, pretty and delicious. I've been working for a company around here for 6 years, and the kimbap here is the best. The man is so kind. He repaired the kimbap that was torn on the side and gave it to me. It's cute. But the red pepper kimbap is super spicy. I also eat fried chicken, but I cried while eating this. I ate less pepper. Just eat spicy cilantro.

reviews.author: Junsu Kim
reviews.text:
The person taking my order was very unfriendly. “Welcome, how can I help you with your order?” I was left standing still without any basic greetings, and even after receiving my order, I didn’t respond and I felt ignored. The food wasn't tasty and it tasted like a lot of seasoning.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
I'm writing this again because I'm dumbfounded that you lied so much in the answer you posted below. During lunch time, there were only about 3 customers, including me, and they didn't even say hello, let alone "close service". They even took our orders behind our backs, but they almost lied and said it was because they were very busy during lunch time, which is really outrageous. The woman doing the food did it inside, and that's what the man did when he took the order. Don't lie.

Response from the owner 12 minutes ago
I guess you came during lunch. As you can see, it's hard to serve closely during a busy lunch time because I'm the only one in the hall calculating the servings instead of the kimbap. I'm sorry if I offended you. That's not the case except during busy lunch times. I always say hello... Anyway, I'm sorry.
